contrastCalculations.method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance (linearization threshold0.04045), (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05). Opaque grayscale two-stop gradient endpoints bound interior luminance; this requires actual opacity/filter/background assumptions to hold. A reported axe contrastRatio0 for bgGradient/shortTextContent means uncomputed, not0:1.
